description: Create or update a workflow. Required for new: name, objekt_typ (deal|lead|project|asbest_project|contact|… any object type). Optional: workflow_id (update), beschreibung, zuruecksetzen ('erlaubt'|'mit_grund' (default: going back needs a reason)|'nur_kanten' (only over defined zurueck edges)|'verboten'), aktiv. Pipedrive pipelines/boards are created with import_pipedrive_workflow instead.

objekt_muster.description: Regex with ONE capture group that finds the object id in mail subjects/texts for signals. Default for deals: \bDN\s*[-–]?\s*(\d{3,6})\b

objekt_typ.description: Object type the workflow applies to (e.g. deal, lead); required for new

zuruecksetzen.description: Rule for moving objects back; default mit_grund (needs a reason)

name: upsert_workflow
